on PrepareQuestionListWidget
	local tTest
	put 1 into tTest["key"]
	try 
		put jsonexport(tTest) into tTest
		catch tError
		answer terror
	end try
	
	 local tJavascriptHandlers
	 local tBrowserName, tStack, tScript
	 local xIndex, xID, tRecords, tDataA
	 local tJSON, tEncodedJSON, tJS, tUTF8JSON,tQuizMeta, tDo
	
	 if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	 else
		 put "Appli" into tStack
	 end if
	
	 put "browser cs control " into tBrowserName
	 put gAppliA["questionListBrowserID"]["Data"] after tBrowserName
	
	 // THIS LINE NUMBER MIGHT NEED UPDATING SOMETIMES IF THIS SCRIPT CHANGES.
	 put line 52 to 500 of the script of me into tScript
	 put "global gAppliA" & lf before tScript
	
	 put "HearQuestionAudio" into tJavascriptHandlers
	 put lf & "EditQuestion" after tJavascriptHandlers
	 put lf & "DeleteSelectedQuestions" after tJavascriptHandlers
	 put lf & "QuestionListDataChanged" after tJavascriptHandlers
	
	 set the javascripthandlers of widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tJavascriptHandlers
	 set the script of widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tScript
	
	// GET THE QUIZ META KEY
	put cdb_lookUpValue(AuthedUserQuizzesTable, editTheQuizID,"QuizMeta","local") into tQuizMeta 
	
	 // MAKE THE ARRAY TO SEND AS JSON TO BROWSER BASED LIST
	 put cdb_read(AuthedUserQuestionsTable, editQuizQuestions, "local") into tRecords
	 put 0 into xIndex
	
	 repeat for each key xID in tRecords
		 add 1 to xIndex
		 put tRecords[xID] into tDataA["list"][xIndex]
		 delete variable tDataA["list"][xIndex]["cdb"]
		put tRecords[xID]["QuestionData"]["StateStandard"] into tDataA["list"][xIndex]["StateStandard"]
		//	answer tDataA["list"][xIndex]["StateStandard"]
	 end repeat
	
	// ADD DATA TO ARRAY
	
	put tQuizMeta["map"] into tDataA["map"]
	put tQuizMeta["rubrics"] into tDataA["rubrics"]
	try
		put JSONExport(tDataA) into tJSON
		catch tError
		put ArrayToJSON(tDataA) into tJSON
		//put textDecode(tJSON, "native") into tJSON
	end try
	
	put textEncode(tJSON, "UTF-8") into tUTF8JSON
	put base64Encode(tUTF8JSON) into tEncodedJSON
	replace cr with empty in tEncodedJSON
	replace lf with empty in tEncodedJSON
	//	put ""; breakpoint
	set the htmltext of widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to questionListHTML 
	
	
	wait 250 milliseconds with messages
	put "window.setQuestionsFromLiveCode('" & tEncodedJSON & "');" into tJS
	do tJS in widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
end PrepareQuestionListWidget

on QuestionListDataChanged pDataJSON
	global gSelectedScreen
	
	local tDataA,tQuestionTable,tQuizTable,tQuizMeta, tTempA, tResultA,tQuestionTableName
	try 
		put JSONToArray(pDataJSON) into tDataA
		catch tError
		answer tError
		exit QuestionListDataChanged
	end try
	put "Changed"; breakpoint
	if tDataA["change"] is empty then
		unlock screen 
		get answerDialog("There was a problem with the data from the list","OK")
		exit QuestionListDataChanged
	else
	end if
	
	if tDataA["change"] contains "order" then
		delete variable tDataA["change"]
		put cdb_tableID(authedUserQuestionsTable) into tQuestionTableName
		repeat for each key xQuestionID in tDataA
			put tDataA[xQuestionID] into tTempA[tQuestionTableName][xQuestionID]
		end repeat
		put tTempA into tDataA
		cdb_batchUpdate tDataA,"local"
		cdb_batchUpdate tDataA,"cloud"
	end if
	
	
	if tDataA["change"] contains "rubric data" then
		 put cdb_lookUpValue(authedUserQuizzesTable, editTheQuizID, "QuizMeta", "local") into tQuizMeta
	
		 if "map" is among the keys of tDataA then
			 put tDataA["map"] into tQuizMeta["map"]
		 end if
		 
		 if "rubrics" is among the keys of tDataA then
			 put tDataA["rubrics"] into tQuizMeta["rubrics"]
		 end if
		 
		 put empty into tDataA
		 put tQuizMeta into tDataA["QuizMeta"]
		 
		 cdb_update tDataA, AuthedUserQuizzesTable, editTheQuizID, "local"
		 
		 put cdb_sync(editTheQuizID, AuthedUserQuizzesTable, "local", false, false) into tResultA
		 
		 put tResultA
	end if
end QuestionListDataChanged
